verified_structure.storage_progress_callback: recorder_runtime.capture_progress calls cooperative_pipeline_pump while synchronous storage access progresses
verified_structure.save_scope: recording_store_save includes begin, age_write_recording with interleaved ciphertext writes, commit; commit includes f_sync, close, rename, CTRL_SYNC
verified_structure.sleep: main uses WFI with 1ms SysTick; not a proof of Stop mode or low measured current
verified_structure.clock_profile: MSIS16 CPU, MSIK3.072MHz ADF, PCLK2 16MHz SPI, HSI16 off
verified_structure.instruction_cache: ICACHE one-way required fail-closed at startup

acceptance_run_contract.firmware: same configured BIN and source/build/config hashes on all units; debugger detached; no diagnostic instrumentation
acceptance_run_contract.start_state: charge each pack in the candidate board to normal termination, rest 30 minutes disconnected, storage preconditioned to at least 80 percent allocated, then cold boot recording
acceptance_run_contract.recording: at least 57600 seconds continuous, 16000Hz mono, silence retained, five-second encrypted segments, no USB power
acceptance_run_contract.ambient_primary: 25C +/-2C in still air after thermal stabilization
acceptance_run_contract.electrical_capture: battery-side voltage and current from before boot until controlled stop; raw sample rate at least 100kS/s or instrument peak-detect bandwidth at least 100kHz; calibrated range must cover 0 to at least 150mA without autorange gaps
per_unit_pass: recording duration >=57600s without reset, stop, queue overflow or fault
integrated discharge charge <=70.4mAh and average current <=4.4mA over the complete run
observed battery current <=110mA; instrument bandwidth and uncertainty recorded, so observed samples alone are not promoted to a peak bound
all expected encrypted segments through the full interval exist, authenticate, decrypt and decode
decoded sample count >=921600000 with no sequence gap, duplicate interval or hidden silence omission
completed files remain recoverable after normal stop; incomplete tail is reported rather than silently discarded
acceptance_run_contract.release_rule: All five units pass the primary run. Endpoint repeats must also demonstrate >=16h using the qualified cutoff; any failure keeps the design on HOLD and triggers power redesign, not requirement relaxation.

required_observations: CPU awake fraction or equivalent GPIO timing with quantified probe overhead
storage internal-busy current after CS release
audio queue high-water and overflow fault
diagnostic_capture_contract.decision_threshold: If battery average exceeds4.4mA or the 70.4mAh integral, identify the dominant rail. If non-storage dominates, qualify tickless idle while preserving HAL time and ADF/LPDMA continuity; if storage dominates, change batching/media only after verifying audio backlog and durability.

measurement_rules: Primary energy evidence is battery-side integrated current over the complete run, including startup, ordinary capture, encryption, filesystem metadata, sync and indicators. Do not add nested timing-derived current estimates to this integral.
recording_store_save elapsed duration is an inclusive software interval, not SD active time. Crypto writes and audio progress are nested; do not sum their inclusive durations.

An SPI CS or clock observation cannot alone establish SD internal active/idle current. Relate bus activity to measured current without assigning the datasheet active current to every software save interval.

Use an unchanged non-instrumented application for the acceptance runtime test. Any diagnostic build requires matched compiler flags/configuration and paired current captures to bound instrumentation overhead.
Do not attach a powered USB host or debugger during the battery-runtime acceptance capture. Any diagnostic probe setup must document additional loading and possible back-power.

On-device diagnostic counters, if implemented, should aggregate in RAM without per-block serial/USB prints, flash writes or interrupt masking. Export after recording stops; instrumentation not yet implemented.
Record queue high-water, sticky overflow/fault state, committed sample count, build hash and battery cutoff reason. Queue occupancy alone cannot prove decrypted audio continuity.
Validate decrypted audio sample totals and sequence continuity independently, including silence; a 16-hour current trace alone is insufficient.

host_evidence.scope: host simulation with sanitizers; not hardware latency, power, media reliability or 16h runtime
